title: Mulch for moisture and soil protection
subcategory: Mulch for moisture and soil protection
summary: Cover bare soil while preventing stem rot, pests and contaminated inputs.
steps: Water and weed before applying clean mulch.
Use a moderate loose layer of straw, shredded leaves or another locally suitable material.
Leave a clear ring around stems and trunks to maintain airflow.
Inspect beneath mulch for slugs, rodents, persistent wetness or fungal growth.
Top up only after checking soil moisture; do not create a permanently saturated layer.
